policy.parentAndChildIdentityChecks: Use actual V3 selected parent Image plus child ImageManifestDescriptor, with exact Config.Image and platform.
isolation: private bounded tmpfs only; fixed readonly owned input snapshots; no repository/HOME/socket/credentials/writable host mounts
operations: Read/hash exact apt/gpgv/dpkg/tool paths, base package status and Ubuntu archive keyring. No install or apt update.

After bounded host acquisition, verify signatures using the captured trusted base keyring/tool identities; offline dependency resolution against authenticated indexes and captured base status, with no package transfer.
Verify selected signer fingerprint, signed date/suite/component/architecture and strongest signed index size/hash. Reject missing or changed authority.
All-outcome exact owned container/group/temp cleanup; retained immutable evidence/package lock allowed within fixed owned directory.

selectedChanges: Remove only --no-download from selected APT command; require --simulate, --no-install-recommends, no suggested packages and --no-remove. Never use ignore-missing/fix-missing/unauthenticated.
Preserve network-none, readonly, nonroot and all existing native/stream/time/storage limits; one container only.
Reuse exact authenticated metadata and base status/keyring hashes; same early and all-outcome evidence exports.
Derive exact dependency/version lock only on successful native simulation with full signed index provenance; report any base runtime upgrades.
Preserve all previous failures and exact owned cleanup.
notSelected: Shared/global package installs or apt state changes
officialSemanticsObserved: APT2.8.3 documentation: simulation changes no system state; no-download restricts available archives to already downloaded packages. Exact failure cause remains a hypothesis before retry.
